elgato.controlCenter.brightnessChanged.description: Runs when a light's brightness changes. Cuebot checks the lights about every 2 seconds, so it also notices changes made in other apps.

fields.device: Which light to watch: its name, serial number or network address (IP), like "Key Light Left". Separate several with commas. Leave empty to react to every light.

variables.deviceName: The name of the light, as set in Control Center
variables.temperature: Color warmth now, in Kelvin (low is orange, high is blue)
variables.ipAddress: The light's address on your network

elgato.controlCenter.colorChanged.description: Runs when the color of a color light, like the Light Strip, changes. Cuebot checks the lights about every 2 seconds, so it also notices changes made in other apps.

fields.device: Which light to watch: its name, serial number or network address (IP), like "Key Light Left". Separate several with commas. Leave empty to react to every light.

variables.deviceName: The name of the light, as set in Control Center
variables.temperature: Color warmth now, in Kelvin (low is orange, high is blue)
variables.ipAddress: The light's address on your network
variables.hue: The new color position on the color wheel (0-360)
variables.oldHue: The color position before the change
variables.oldSaturation: The color strength before the change

elgato.controlCenter.setBrightness.description: Changes how bright your Elgato light is.

fields.device: Which light to change: its name, serial number or network address (IP), like "Key Light Left". Separate several with commas. All (the default) means every light.
fields.brightness: How bright, from 0 to 100. With Adjustment ticked, how much to add or take away.
fields.adjustment: Tick to add your number to the current setting instead of replacing it. Use a negative number to go down, like -10.

variables.deviceName: The name of the first light changed
variables.powerState: On or Off, after the change
variables.temperature: Its color warmth after the change, in Kelvin
variables.hue: Its color position (0-360), if it is a color light
variables.saturation: Its color strength (0-100), if it is a color light

elgato.controlCenter.setPowerState.description: Turns your Elgato light on or off.

fields.device: Which light to change: its name, serial number or network address (IP), like "Key Light Left". Separate several with commas. All (the default) means every light.
fields.state: On turns the light on, Off turns it off, Toggle flips it to the opposite of what it is now.

variables.deviceName: The name of the first light changed
variables.powerState: On or Off, after the change
variables.temperature: Its color warmth after the change, in Kelvin
variables.hue: Its color position (0-360), if it is a color light
variables.saturation: Its color strength (0-100), if it is a color light

elgato.controlCenter.setTemperature.description: Changes how warm (orange) or cool (blue) the white light is.

fields.device: Which light to change: its name, serial number or network address (IP), like "Key Light Left". Separate several with commas. All (the default) means every light.
fields.temperature: Color warmth in Kelvin, from 2900 (warm, orange) to 7000 (cool, blue). With Adjustment ticked, how many Kelvin to add or take away.
fields.adjustment: Tick to add your number to the current setting instead of replacing it. Use a negative number to go down, like -10.

variables.deviceName: The name of the first light changed
variables.powerState: On or Off, after the change
variables.temperature: Its color warmth after the change, in Kelvin
variables.hue: Its color position (0-360), if it is a color light
variables.saturation: Its color strength (0-100), if it is a color light

elgato.controlCenter.setColor.description: Sets the color of a color light, like the Elgato Light Strip. Plain white lights such as the Key Light have no color.

fields.device: Which light to change: its name, serial number or network address (IP), like "Key Light Left". Separate several with commas. All (the default) means every light.
fields.hue: The color, from 0 to 360 around the color wheel: 0 is red, 120 is green, 240 is blue.
fields.saturation: How strong the color is, from 0 (white) to 100 (full color).

variables.deviceName: The name of the first light changed
variables.powerState: On or Off, after the change
variables.temperature: Its color warmth after the change, in Kelvin
variables.hue: Its color position (0-360), if it is a color light
variables.saturation: Its color strength (0-100), if it is a color light

elgato.controlCenter.identify.description: Makes your Elgato light blink for a moment so you can see which one it is.

fields.device: Which light to change: its name, serial number or network address (IP), like "Key Light Left". Separate several with commas. All (the default) means every light.

elgato.controlCenter.getDevice.description: Reads a light's current settings into variables you can use in later steps.

fields.device: Which light to change: its name, serial number or network address (IP), like "Key Light Left". Separate several with commas. All (the default) means every light.

variables.deviceName: The name of the first light changed
variables.powerState: On or Off, after the change
variables.temperature: Its color warmth after the change, in Kelvin
variables.hue: Its color position (0-360), if it is a color light
variables.saturation: Its color strength (0-100), if it is a color light
variables.productName: The kind of light, like Key Light
variables.online: true if the light is answering
